homonyms.basis: The census row carries no disambiguation field. No card is a homonym: every card concerns the library. The shorter name 'Dead Sea Scrolls Digital Library' (the census's aka; the Orion page's title, B3) is shared in form by distinct digital collections of the scrolls the field names; 'Leon Levy' is the financier and the Leon Levy Foundation, whose name other works bear; and 'the library' in the archive's seat of the scrolls (#1531) is the archive's own originals library. The distinct entities below are never senses of the name.
distinct_entities: the Israel Museum's Digital Dead Sea Scrolls / Scrolls Online (dss.collections.imj.org.il), photographed in partnership with Google, the Great Isaiah Scroll, the Community Rule, the War Scroll, the Pesher on Habakkuk and the Temple Scroll (B3 F37; B8 F38)
the Leon Levy Foundation and the Arcadia Fund, the funders (B5 F25); the Shelby White & Leon Levy Lod Mosaic Center, another work bearing the name (B5's navigation)
Google and Google Arts and Culture, the partner (B5 F25; B8 F31; B1 F5)
the Palestine Archaeological Museum (the Rockefeller Museum), whose 1950s plates the library scans (B8 F32; B5 F29)
the Orion Center for the Study of the Dead Sea Scrolls and its Bibliography, Hebrew University (B3)
Scripta Qumranica Electronica, the digital-edition platform that combines the library's images with the Göttingen Qumran dictionary (B3 F22)
the Dead Sea Scrolls Electronic Library (Brill), listed beside the library in Wikipedia's 'Other sources' (B8)
the Enoch dating study, the census's related entity (RF-21; census row enoch-dss-dating)
the archive's originals library and its seat 02/01 'dss' (#1531, #1709), which 'the library' names in the archive's own records

T: the closer's 'the Great Isaiah Scroll or the Community Rule', named by card 3 for the Israel Museum's Scrolls Online (F37), offered as texts to find in 'the archive'

captures.q: Leon Levy Dead Sea Scrolls Digital Library
captures.description: THE LEON LEVY DEAD SEA SCROLLS DIGITAL LIBRARY, BY NAME, ON GOOGLE'S AI OVERVIEW, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-31: 'a free, searchable online database created by the Israel Antiquities Authority in partnership with Google.' Multispectral imaging at '12 different wavelengths', thousands of fragments 'discovered in the Judean Desert between 1947 and the early 1960s', search filters, the P.A.M. negatives, the library's link. Six cards: the library's own site, a blog, the Hebrew University, two IAA videos, the Friends of the IAA.

atoms.evidence: The Leon Levy Dead Sea Scrolls Digital Library is a free, searchable online database
created by the Israel Antiquities Authority
Preserves thousands of ancient scroll fragments and hundreds of manuscripts discovered in the Judean Desert between 1947 and the early 1960s
Massive Archive: Preserves thousands of ancient scroll fragments
P.A.M. Negatives: Includes digital scans of historic Palestine Archaeological Museum photographic negatives from the 1950s.
